purpose: Prevent protected external resources from becoming target-construction or tuning data after NIH-CARD/E2 work.

Morabito.protected_outcome_family: target-state cis/regulatory correspondence for the future exact integrated target
allowed_before_target_freeze: previously exposed RNA/coactivity or marginal ATAC families only as explicitly ledgered
forbidden_before_target_freeze: using protected values to select E2 edges, integration weights, q-safety path, nuisance basis, or thresholds

required_before_opening: prospectively frozen donor-level estimand and support/missingness rules
after_opening: No redesign of E2, integrated target, nuisance basis, or validation threshold using the opened protected family.
